content: {"praised": ["Characters are well portrayed, making the comedy feel fresh.", "Storyline flows smoothly with unexpected tender and funny moments.", "Editing is great, no choppiness, pacing feels natural.", "Gay couple portrayed as ordinary, everyday life, no stereotypes.", "Heartwarming and charming, especially the hockey-themed elements."], "criticized": ["Film feels dull, contrived, and predictable at times.", "Acting is stiff, especially the lead and jock roles.", "Sitcom-like direction undercuts the importance of the subject.", "Adult actors contribute little, story relies on child actor.", "Storyline is formulaic, events are predictable."]}
